title: Refund webhook retries issue duplicate refunds
text: The provider's refund webhook timed out and our handler retried; Brightpath's patient got the same refund twice.
repro:
1. Refund an invoice.
2. Make the webhook ack slow (over 10 s) so the provider retries.
3. Two refunds land for one invoice.
done: A retried refund webhook refunds once; the refund key is `ref_<invoiceId>` on every attempt.

title: Annual plan invoice total is off by one cent
text: Kestrel's annual invoice shows CA$11,999.99 while the plan price is CA$12,000.00.
repro:
1. Annual plan with a 12-month line split into monthly items.
2. Generate the invoice.
3. Total is one cent short.
done: All invoice math in integer cents, rounding half to even only on the final line; totals match the plan price.

title: Proration bills Northwind a day early
text: Northwind upgraded late in the evening Pacific time and was charged for an extra day.
repro:
1. Account with billing timezone America/Los_Angeles.
2. Upgrade at 18:00 local time.
3. The proration counts the next day too.
done: Proration uses `account.billing_tz`, never UTC; a test upgrades near midnight.

title: Receipt emails for failed charges
text: Acme's finance team wants an email when a charge fails, with a link to update the card.
done: A final failed charge enqueues one email on the mailer queue (never sent inline); retries send nothing.

title: Password reset links expire instantly for users in Sydney
text: Orchard tutors in Australia click a fresh reset link and see 'link expired'.
repro:
1. User with timezone Australia/Sydney.
2. Request a password reset.
3. Open the link within a minute: expired.
done: Expiry is compared in UTC with the 120 second skew allowance; a test covers a far-east timezone.

title: OIDC login loops when the identity provider clock is behind
text: Northwind's backup IdP runs two minutes slow; logins bounce back to the IdP in a loop.
repro:
1. OIDC provider clock 90 seconds behind.
2. Sign in.
3. The id token is rejected as not yet valid, redirect loop.
done: iat, nbf and exp checks all allow 120 seconds of skew in both directions.

title: Password reset links appear in debug logs
text: Kestrel's security review found full reset URLs in our debug log export.
repro:
1. Set log level debug.
2. Request a password reset.
3. The log line contains the full reset link.
done: No token, assertion or reset link is logged at any level; a test greps the logs.

title: Remember me for 30 days
text: Acme wants a 'remember me' checkbox so engineers stay signed in on their own laptops.
done: Remember me extends the refresh token lifetime to 30 days; sessions refresh by refresh token, never by a forced SSO round trip.

title: Trial ends early for workspaces created on a Friday
text: A Brightpath clinic created its workspace on Friday, invited staff on Monday, and lost three trial days.
repro:
1. Create a workspace.
2. Invite a teammate three days later.
3. The trial banner shows 11 days left when they accept.
done: The trial clock starts when the first invited teammate accepts, not at workspace creation.

title: Welcome email sent twice after an invite resend
text: Orchard admins resent an invite and the teammate got two welcome emails, one of them instantly.
repro:
1. Invite a teammate.
2. Click resend.
3. One email arrives at once, another later from the queue.
done: Resend enqueues on the mailer queue like the first send; nothing is sent inline from the request handler; one welcome email per accept.

title: CSV import invites half the list, then fails
text: Row 23 of Brightpath's CSV had a bad email; the first 22 staff were invited and the rest were not.
repro:
1. CSV with 40 rows, row 23 malformed.
2. Import.
3. 22 invites go out, then an error.
done: The whole file is validated first (all or nothing); a bad row sends zero invites and reports the row.

title: Invite teammates by email domain
text: Acme wants anyone with an @acme-robotics.example address to be able to join without an invite.
done: Domain matching compares lowercase, trimmed emails; joining by domain starts the trial like an accepted invite.

title: Noon reindex slows search for every workspace
text: Every day at 12:00 search takes 8 seconds for Northwind dispatchers.
repro:
1. Trigger the scheduled reindex at noon.
2. Search from any workspace.
3. Latency jumps from 80 ms to 8 s.
done: Reindex runs per workspace and never globally during business hours.

title: Autocomplete suggests project names from other workspaces
text: A Kestrel user typing 'Gen' saw 'Genome Plan B' from a different customer's workspace.
repro:
1. Two workspaces with similar project names.
2. Type a prefix in autocomplete.
3. Suggestions include the other workspace's names.
done: Autocomplete scopes by `workspace_id` inside the index query on the live and cached paths; never post-filters.

title: Toggle to include archived items in search
text: Orchard teachers want to find last term's archived courses.
done: An include-archived toggle changes the `archived` filter inside the query; the workspace scope never changes.
